summary: Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC filed an 8-K on June 5, 2026, reporting the issuance and sale of $2.4 billion aggregate principal amount of its First and Refunding Mortgage Bonds across three series (4.65% due 2031, 5.15% due 2036, 5.75% due 2056) under an underwriting agreement with representatives including CIBC World Markets, J.P. Morgan, and others. The bonds were sold at discounts and issued under a 1927 mortgage indenture, as supplemented. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No terms such as price per share, premium, or acquisition were stated.
